WHEREAS by reason of the existence of a grave emergency
threatening the security of Malaysia, a Proclamation of P.U. (4)
Emergency has been issued by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong Hae
under Article 150 of the Constitution;

AND WHEREAS Parliament was dissolved on the twentieth P.U. (4)
day of March, 1969, and elections to the new Dewan Ra'ayat  94/69.
have not been completed;

AND WHEREAS the Yang di-Pertuan Agong is satisfied
that immediate action is required for an Ordinance to be
promulgated to amend the Financial Procedure Ordinance, 62/57.
1957;

IT IS HEREBY ENACTED by the Duli Yang Maha
Mulia Seri Paduka Baginda Yang di-Pertuan Agong
pursuant to Clause (2) of Article 150 of the Constitution as
follows:
